item.tib: 'phags pa lag na rdo rje gos sngon po can zhes bya ba'i rgyud kyi rnam par bshad pa
item.skt: nI lAM ba ra d+ha ra badzra pA Ni Ar+ya nA ma tan+t+ra TI kA
item.coloph: 'phags pa gos sngon po can gyi rtsa ba'i rgyud kyi 'grel pa rdzogs so/ /skye ba lnga brgyar blo rab sbyangs/ /sngags kyi theg pa'i bstan bcos 'di/ /dbu ma'i lta bar yang dag ste/ /mkhas btsun rnams kyi yongs su gzung / /sgrol ma gsal ba zhes bya ba'i 'grel pa dge slong klu'i byang chub kyis mdzad pa rdzogs so
